name: Elixir + Phoenix 1.7+ + LiveView + Ecto + PostgreSQL
note: Requires the Elixir/Mix toolchain. This kit ships test support files but no ExUnit cases yet — task-04 will pass vacuously until cases are added. Token figures are not recorded here; evals/runner.py measures context cost from the kit files.

eval_tasks.title: Dependencies resolve
eval_tasks.instruction: mix must fetch the locked dependency set.

eval_tasks.title: Compiles with warnings treated as errors
eval_tasks.instruction: The application must compile with zero warnings.

eval_tasks.title: Sobelow static security analysis is clean
eval_tasks.instruction: Sobelow must report no findings for the Phoenix application.

eval_tasks.title: Test suite passes
eval_tasks.instruction: The ExUnit suite must pass. NOTE: this kit currently ships only test/support and test_helper; adding real cases is tracked as a gap.
